list_child.name: list_sessions
list_child.desc: This tool retrieves every charging session currently tracked by the network. It returns the full list regardless of station or fleet.

get_child.name: get_session
get_child.desc: This tool fetches a single charging session using its unique identifier. It returns the complete session record for that id.

list_parent.name: list_fleets
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every fleet account registered on the charging network. It includes both individual and business fleet accounts.

get_parent.name: get_fleet
get_parent.desc: This tool fetches a single fleet account using its unique identifier. It returns the full account record.

delete_child.name: purge_session
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently removes a charging session record from the network. The deletion cannot be undone once it is executed.

set_enum.name: set_session_state
set_enum.desc: This tool changes a charging session's state among queued, charging, completed, and faulted. It is used to correct or advance the session's recorded lifecycle.

set_bool.name: flag_fault
set_bool.desc: This tool flags a charging session as faulted due to a hardware or connectivity problem. It is typically used after a station reports an error code.

set_ref.name: transfer_fleet
set_ref.desc: This tool moves a charging session to a different fleet account, for example when billing was attributed incorrectly. The session's history and energy totals remain attached to the record.

send.name: email_fleet
send.desc: This tool sends an email notification to the fleet account associated with a session. It is used to alert fleets about session status or billing issues.

sort.ord_phrase: the session with the {ord} earliest start time
